components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lime primary CTA for mark-done and other primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); padding: 11px 16px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; background: var(--accent, #c6f25a); color: var(--accent-ink, #10140a); box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow-sm, 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), filter 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); font-family: var(--font, Heebo, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6f25a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); filter: brightness(0.95); }

components.name: Active Tab

components.css: .ds-tab-active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; align-items: flex-start; text-align: start; padding: 12px 12px 11px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 18px); background: var(--accent, #c6f25a); color: var(--accent-ink, #10140a); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow-lg, 0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); font-family: var(--font, Heebo, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); transition: filter 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tab-title { font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-tab-sub { font-size: 0.75rem; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-tab-active:hover { filter: brightness(1.02); } .ds-tab-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6f25a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tab-active:active { filter: brightness(0.95); transform: scale(0.98); }

components.css: .ds-stage-card { border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.28)); border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 22px) + 4px); background: var(--glass-fill-strong, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)); box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow-lg, 0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight, rgba(255,255,255,0.58)), inset 0 -0.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06); backdrop-filter: blur(48px) saturate(1.3); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(48px) saturate(1.3); overflow: hidden; color: var(--text, #f5f5f7); font-family: var(--font, Heebo, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); max-width: 360px; } .ds-stage-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 11; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a1a1c, #0a0a0c 60%, rgba(198,242,90,0.08)); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-stage-body { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 16px 18px; } .ds-stage-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-stage-muscle { margin: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted, #a1a1a6); font-size: 0.88rem; } .ds-stage-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #c6f25a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #c6f25a) 25%, transparent); } .ds-stage-done { width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 16px; min-height: 48px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; background: var(--accent, #c6f25a); color: var(--accent-ink, #10140a); } .ds-stage-done:hover { filter: brightness(1.03); } .ds-stage-done:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6f25a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-stage-done:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.css: .ds-lib-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr; gap: 12px; box-sizing: border-box; height: 140px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.28)); border-radius: var(--radius, 22px); background: var(--glass-fill, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow, 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight, rgba(255,255,255,0.58)); backdrop-filter: blur(48px) saturate(1.3); color: var(--text, #f5f5f7); font-family: var(--font, Heebo, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); max-width: 420px; } .ds-lib-thumb { width: 96px; height: 120px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a1a1c, #0a0a0c); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.28)); } .ds-lib-meta { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-lib-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-lib-tip { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #a1a1a6); font-size: 0.8rem; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-lib-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: 160px 1fr; height: 300px; } .ds-lib-thumb { width: 100%; height: 160px; } }

narrative.overview:
A mobile-first, Hebrew-RTL training companion rendered as cool near-black iOS System Liquid Glass — clear refractive fills, specular rims, and a floating dock — not muddy olive frosted slabs. The workout surface is Dock & Stage: one dominant glass stage for the active exercise, a horizontal tray for what’s next, and a fixed bottom dock for app navigation.

Density stays gym-phone practical: scannable mid-set, large tap targets (44px+), and lime reserved for primary and active chrome only. Atmosphere comes from fixed radial washes on the near-black field plus layered glass, not from purple gradients or cream editorial skins.
keyCharacteristics: Cool near-black field (#0a0a0c) with clear refractive glass and specular inset rims
Dock & Stage workout composition (stage → tray → floating dock)
Lime #c6f25a only for primary CTAs and active selection
Heebo / IBM Plex Sans (+ Hebrew) stack; RTL-first

rules.name: The Lime Rarity Rule
rules.body: Lime appears only on primary actions and true active/selected chrome. Never wash backgrounds, glass fills, or large surfaces with accent.

rules.name: The Clear Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass is cool and refractive (blur 48px / 28px, saturate 1.9) with specular inset rims — not olive-tinted or heavily frosted mud.

rules.name: The Hebrew-First Stack Rule
rules.body: Always keep Heebo + IBM Plex Sans Hebrew in the stack; do not substitute Inter/Roboto/system-only for UI chrome.

rules.name: The Reduced-Transparency Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce, glass fills map to opaque --panel / --panel-2, blur tokens go to 0, and backdrop-filter is removed on chrome and glass components.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion Rule
rules.body: Press-scale transforms and card-body rise animation disable under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

dos: Do keep lime (#c6f25a) only on primary CTAs and active/selected chrome.
Do preserve library card heights 140px / 300px (≤420px) and 12px gap in both CSS and LibraryView constants.
Do use clear cool glass fills with specular inset rims and the documented blur/saturate tokens.
Do provide opaque --panel / --panel-2 fallbacks when prefers-reduced-transparency is set.
Do keep the Heebo / IBM Plex Sans (+ Hebrew) stack and RTL-first layout.
Do keep 44px+ tap targets on primary controls and the floating dock clear of content via app bottom padding.
donts: Don't reintroduce muddy olive / frosted green glass panels.
Don't wash backgrounds or large surfaces with lime; rarity is the signal.
Don't break the Dock & Stage workout composition (stage + tray + floating dock) into a dashboard of equal cards.
Don't change the library card size contract without updating both CSS and LibraryView constants together.
Don't ship glass-only UI without the reduced-transparency opaque path.
Don't swap in Inter, Roboto, Arial, or purple-on-white / cream-serif default AI skins.
